items.zh: 为了升职连着一个多月天天加班，值吗？
items.scene: 朋友为升职连轴转，你吃饭时问他

answers.en: Is it worth working late every night for a promotion?
answers.note: 用 it 作形式主语泛问值不值，不针对眼前这个人；适合先把问题摆上桌聊。

answers.en: You've been working late for a month straight for this promotion — is it really worth it?
answers.note: 直接拿朋友这一个多月的加班说事，really 带心疼和质疑；适合当面问他本人。

answers.en: Would you trade your evenings for a shot at a promotion?
answers.note: trade...for... 把加班说成拿晚上去换机会，带取舍感；适合聊职业代价，不逼人表态。

items.zh: 你担心AI哪天会取代你这份工作吗？
items.scene: 同事聚餐聊新AI系统，你问他

answers.en: Do you ever worry that AI could take over your job?
answers.note: 用 ever 把担心说成偶尔冒出来的念头，语气平常；适合饭桌上顺口问一句。

answers.en: Are you worried AI is coming for your job?
answers.note: be coming for 有“盯上、冲着来”的画面，威胁感比第一条强；适合对方刚被AI工具冲击时。

answers.en: How worried are you that AI will replace what you do?
answers.note: How worried 问担心的程度，不逼人回答担不担心；适合对方态度还不明确时。

items.zh: 公司要求每周回办公室四天，你愿意吗？
items.scene: HR发邮件减远程天数，你问同事

answers.en: Would you be okay going back to the office four days a week?
answers.note: be okay 问能不能接受，态度中性，像确认对方底线；适合刚看到通知时问同事。

answers.en: How would you feel about being in the office four days a week?
answers.note: How would you feel 把问题变成聊感受，比直接问愿不愿意温和；适合对方还没表态时。

answers.en: Would you push back if they made you come in four days a week?
answers.note: push back 指明确反对，句子假定对方不乐意；适合自己也反感、想找同盟时。

items.zh: 在大城市打拼五年，你还会劝年轻人留下吗？
items.scene: 和老同学聊他这五年在上海的打拼，你问他

answers.en: After five years in the big city, would you still tell young people to stay?
answers.note: 直接问还会不会劝人留下，把五年经历当背景；适合老同学之间交换看法。

answers.en: Knowing what you know now, would you encourage someone to move to a big city?
answers.note: Knowing what you know now 强调事后回看，问法更理性；适合认真复盘这些年的得失。

answers.en: Five years in, do you still think the big city is worth it for young people?
answers.note: Five years in 指“五年下来”，worth it 带怀疑；适合对方话里已经露出疲惫时。

items.zh: 刚发年终奖，你会存起来还是给自己买个新手机？
items.scene: 同事晒年终奖，你顺口问他

answers.en: You just got your bonus — are you saving it or spending it on yourself?
answers.note: saving it or spending it 直接摆出两个去向，语气随意；适合刚发钱、彼此打听时。

answers.en: Are you going to put your bonus away, or treat yourself to something?
answers.note: put away 是口语“存起来”，treat yourself 指犒劳自己；适合关系熟、带点玩笑时。

answers.en: What's the smarter move with your bonus — save it or splurge on that new phone you've been eyeing?
answers.note: smarter move 把问题变成哪种做法更明智，splurge 指舍得花一笔；适合对方来问你意见时。

items.zh: 如果房租一直涨，你还会坚持租房不买房吗？
items.scene: 朋友又在算房租涨幅，你问他

answers.en: If rent keeps going up, would you still rent instead of buying?
answers.note: 用 if 假设房租持续上涨，把租房和买房摆成选择；语气平稳，适合一般讨论。

answers.en: At what point would rising rent make you give up and buy a place?
answers.note: At what point 追问涨到什么程度才妥协，give up 带无奈；适合聊承受底线。

answers.en: Is buying really the only answer if rent keeps climbing?
answers.note: only answer 质疑“只能买”这个前提，really 加强反问；适合不认同朋友急着买房时。

items.zh: 你发朋友圈会分组屏蔽同事吗？
items.scene: 同事聊屏蔽领导，你问他

answers.en: Do you hide your WeChat posts from your coworkers?
answers.note: hide...from 指向朋友圈分组屏蔽的具体动作，问法直接；适合同事之间随口聊。

answers.en: Do you keep some posts off your coworkers' feeds?
answers.note: keep...off...feeds 比 hide 委婉，只说同事看不到，不点破平台；适合不想说得太具体时。

answers.en: Are you careful about what your coworkers can see on social media?
answers.note: careful about 问平时是否留意，范围比朋友圈大；适合泛泛聊职场社交边界。

items.zh: 刷短视频停不下来，你觉得该怪算法还是怪自己？
items.scene: 地铁上朋友刷短视频，你问他

answers.en: Do you blame the algorithm or yourself for not being able to stop scrolling?
answers.note: blame...or... 把责任摆到算法和自己之间，问法直接；适合朋友边刷边抱怨时。

answers.en: Is it the algorithm that keeps us hooked, or are we just lacking self-control?
answers.note: hooked 是口语“上瘾”，用 we 把问题扩大到所有人；比第一条更像闲聊。

answers.en: Why can't we put our phones down — is it the app or just us?
answers.note: 先抛出现象再给两个解释，语气像随口感叹；适合轻松自嘲，不逼人认错。

items.zh: 直播间一喊“最后三单”，你会不会忍不住下单？
items.scene: 室友拆直播间快递，你打趣问他

answers.en: Do you ever buy stuff just because a livestream says it's almost sold out?
answers.note: ever 把问题说成偶尔发生的情况，语气轻松；适合室友拆快递时打趣。

answers.en: How often do you cave when they say there are only three left?
answers.note: cave 指忍不住妥协，how often 问频率；比第一条更直接，也给自嘲留空间。

answers.en: Be honest — does 'only three left' ever get you to buy without thinking?
answers.note: Be honest 带朋友拆台的直接，without thinking 点出冲动；适合吐槽直播话术。

items.zh: 为了孩子上个好学校，全家搬进很小的老房子，值吗？
items.scene: 表姐为学区准备搬家，你问她

answers.en: Would you move the whole family into a tiny old apartment just to be near a good school?
answers.note: Would you 把问题变成具体假设，tiny old apartment 对应老房子；适合聊表姐的搬家计划。

answers.en: Is a good school district worth living in a cramped old place?
answers.note: school district 指好学区，worth 直接问值不值；比第一条更像在评估房价和居住条件。

answers.en: How much would you sacrifice to get your kid into a good school?
answers.note: How much would you sacrifice 不问搬不搬，问愿意付出多少；适合把话题拉远一点。

items.zh: 孩子周末排满补习班，你会心疼还是觉得正常？
items.scene: 家长群里晒课表，你问一位家长

answers.en: Does it bother you that kids have tutoring all weekend, or does it seem normal?
answers.note: bother 和 seem normal 摆出两种反应，不带预设；适合家长群里正常交换意见。

answers.en: How do you feel about a kid's weekend being packed with tutoring?
answers.note: How do you feel 只问感受，不逼人站队；比第一条软，适合对方孩子也在补课时。

answers.en: Isn't it too much for a kid to have tutoring all weekend?
answers.note: Isn't it too much 是反问，预设补课太多；适合你已经看不下去、想直接说时。

items.zh: 父母年纪大了，你更想接过来一起住，还是住得近点？
items.scene: 和伴侣商量照顾父母，你问他

answers.en: When your parents get older, would you rather have them live with you or just close by?
answers.note: would you rather 让同住和住附近二选一，close by 语气轻松；适合伴侣间商量。

answers.en: How do you picture caring for your parents when they're older — under one roof or nearby?
answers.note: How do you picture 问心里的打算，under one roof 是“同一屋檐下”；画面更具体。

answers.en: Is living together the only good way to take care of aging parents?
answers.note: only good way 带质疑，问同住是不是唯一解；适合讨论养老观念而非具体安排。

items.zh: 你觉得点外卖选“无需餐具”真的有用吗？
items.scene: 同事点外卖勾了“无需餐具”，你问他

answers.en: Do you think choosing 'no utensils' on takeout orders actually makes a difference?
answers.note: actually 带一点求证，问这个选项到底有没有作用；语气中性，适合认真讨论。

answers.en: Does skipping the free utensils with takeout even matter?
answers.note: even matter 怀疑更强，skipping 指主动不要；适合觉得这做法没什么意义时。

answers.en: Is choosing no utensils just a feel-good gesture, or does it really help?
answers.note: feel-good gesture 指让自己感觉良好的姿态，和 really help 对照；批评意味最重。

items.zh: 每天挤地铁一小时，你还会觉得比开车划算吗？
items.scene: 早高峰挤地铁，你发语音问朋友

answers.en: After an hour squeezed into the subway every day, do you still think it beats driving?
answers.note: beats driving 是口语“比开车强”，带着每天挤车的体验问；适合朋友发语音吐槽。

answers.en: Is the subway still worth it when you're packed in every morning?
answers.note: worth it 问值不值，packed in 强调拥挤；比第一条更直接表达不耐烦。

answers.en: Would you still take the subway over driving if you could afford a car?
answers.note: Would you still 假设买得起车，问会不会改开车；适合聊个人选择而非城市交通。

items.zh: 外卖点多了吃不完，你会硬吃完还是直接扔？
items.scene: 加班吃外卖剩一半，你问同事

answers.en: If you order too much takeout, do you force yourself to finish it or just throw it out?
answers.note: force yourself 对应硬吃完，or just throw it out 很直白；适合边吃边随口问。

answers.en: Do you eat the rest even when you're full, just so it doesn't go to waste?
answers.note: 把重点放在吃饱了还硬吃、只为不浪费，带心理描写；比第一条更具体。

answers.en: What do you do with takeout you can't finish — force it down or toss it?
answers.note: What do you do 问习惯做法，force it down 是硬吃完，toss 指“扔掉”；适合不预设答案时。

items.zh: 你觉得天天吃沙拉，真比家常菜健康吗？
items.scene: 同事天天点轻食，你好奇问他

answers.en: Do you think eating salad every day is actually healthier than home-cooked food?
answers.note: actually 轻问“真的吗”，把沙拉和家常菜对比；语气中性，适合同事间闲聊。

answers.en: Is a daily salad bowl really healthier, or does it just feel that way?
answers.note: just feel that way 点出可能只是感觉健康，质疑比第一条明显；适合对方天天吃沙拉时。

answers.en: Are all these salads really better for you than a normal home-cooked meal?
answers.note: Are all these salads 带反问，better for you 是健康口语；怀疑最强，适合吐槽轻食贵。

items.zh: 办了一年健身卡只去三次，你还会续吗？
items.scene: 健身房销售发续卡优惠，你问朋友

answers.en: You've been to the gym three times all year — are you renewing your membership?
answers.note: 先点出一整年只去三次的事实，再问续不续，带调侃；适合朋友之间互相打趣。

answers.en: Is it worth renewing your gym membership when you barely go?
answers.note: worth 把问题变成划不划算，barely go 指几乎不去；比第一条更冷静。

answers.en: Are you really going to pay for another year you won't use?
answers.note: really 和 another year you won't use 直接戳穿，语气最不客气；适合熟朋友互损。

items.zh: 花五千块去网红城市挤三天，你觉得值吗？
items.scene: 朋友旅行回来抱怨，你问他值不值

answers.en: Was it worth five thousand yuan to spend three days in a city everyone posts about?
answers.note: 用花费加天数的问法，everyone posts about 点出网红属性；适合听朋友抱怨后问。

answers.en: Do you think fighting the crowds in a trendy city for three days is worth that kind of money?
answers.note: fighting the crowds 画面更强，that kind of money 指五千块；比第一条更强调拥挤。

answers.en: Would you pay that much for a quick trip just to say you've been?
answers.note: just to say you've been 暗指只为打卡炫耀；带批评，适合朋友自己也觉得不值时。

items.zh: 好朋友开口借两万，你会借还是想办法推掉？
items.scene: 好友开口借两万，你问伴侣怎么办

answers.en: If a close friend asked to borrow twenty thousand yuan, would you lend it or make an excuse?
answers.note: make an excuse 对应找借口推掉，把借和不借摆成选择；语气中性。

answers.en: Your best friend asks you for a big loan — do you say yes or find a way out?
answers.note: big loan 不点具体数字，find a way out 是“找办法脱身”；比第一条更口语。

answers.en: How do you say no to a good friend asking for money without ruining the friendship?
answers.note: 直接假定不借，问怎么拒绝又不伤感情；适合你已决定不借、只想听说法时。

items.zh: 聚餐有人点了贵酒，你还会跟大家平摊吗？
items.scene: 朋友聚餐结账，你问旁边朋友

answers.en: If someone orders expensive drinks, do you still split the bill evenly?
answers.note: split the bill evenly 是“平摊”的标准说法，still 带一点不情愿；适合讨论规则。

answers.en: Do you speak up when one person's order makes the bill way higher for everyone?
answers.note: speak up 指当场说出来，way higher 强调被拉高；比第一条更关注你会不会开口。

answers.en: Is speaking up worth the awkwardness, or do you just pay and let it go?
answers.note: the awkwardness 指开口那点尴尬，let it go 指算了；适合权衡要不要计较这顿的差价。

items.zh: 同事凑钱给领导买礼物，你会跟着出吗？
items.scene: 部门群凑钱买礼物，你问同事

answers.en: Are you going to chip in for the manager's gift?
answers.note: chip in 是口语“凑份子”，直接问参不参加；适合群里刚发起时问同事。

answers.en: Do you feel like you have to chip in when coworkers collect money for the manager?
answers.note: feel like you have to 问是不是被逼着出，点出人情压力；适合私下抱怨。

answers.en: Is it okay to sit out when the office collects money for a gift, or does it make you look bad?
answers.note: sit out 指不参加，look bad 问会不会影响形象；范围更广，适合讨论职场人情规则。

items.zh: 三年没涨工资，你会先找下家还是先跟老板谈？
items.scene: 朋友抱怨三年没涨薪，你问他

answers.en: If your salary hasn't gone up in three years, would you talk to your boss or start job hunting?
answers.note: 把找老板和找下家并列，问先走哪一步；语气中性，适合正式征求意见。

answers.en: Would you ask for a raise straight out, or quietly start sending out resumes?
answers.note: straight out 指直接开口，quietly 指不声张；这一条比的是方式，不是顺序。

answers.en: How long would you wait for a raise before you started looking?
answers.note: 不问二选一，改问能等多久；适合聊忍耐底线，也方便对方说自己的打算。

items.zh: 同事下班拍短视频做副业，你觉得靠谱吗？
items.scene: 同事聊副业收入，你问他靠不靠谱

answers.en: Do you think making short videos on the side is actually going to work?
answers.note: on the side 就是“做副业”，going to work 问靠不靠谱；actually 带怀疑。

answers.en: Is a side hustle worth giving up your evenings for, or does it just wear you out?
answers.note: 把成本说成晚上时间，wear you out 点出累；比第一条更关注值不值得。

answers.en: Do you think everyone needs a side hustle these days, or is it just hype?
answers.note: 把问题扩大到风气，hype 指炒作；适合讨论副业热，而不是某一个人的选择。

items.zh: 身边朋友都结婚了，你会因为年龄将就吗？
items.scene: 过年亲戚催婚，你问朋友怎么看

answers.en: Would you settle just because all your friends are getting married?
answers.note: settle 指将就着结婚，just because 带不认同；适合同龄人私下聊，不对长辈说。

answers.en: Do you think people should marry by a certain age, or wait for the right person?
answers.note: by a certain age 问该不该有年龄线，right person 给等待留空间；语气最平和。

answers.en: Is it better to be single than to marry someone just because of your age?
answers.note: better...than... 把单身和因年龄结婚对比，价值判断明显；适合认真聊婚姻观。

items.zh: 朋友说养孩子太贵，你觉得钱真是最大问题吗？
items.scene: 朋友刚结婚，你问他要不要孩子

answers.en: Do you think money is really the biggest reason people aren't having kids?
answers.note: really 轻问钱是不是最大原因，biggest 要求排序；适合接朋友的话往下聊。

answers.en: Is cost really what's stopping people from having kids, or is it something else?
answers.note: or is it something else 把别的可能留出来，比第一条更开放；适合不想把原因说死。

answers.en: Can you blame people for not having kids when it costs this much?
answers.note: Can you blame... 是反问，表示完全理解，不是说养孩子不该花钱；语气最共情。
